justification: `core/src/main/java/com/google/googlejavaformat/java/GoogleJavaFormatTool.java` is a thin adapter: it imports only standard JDK types plus Guava/AutoService, and its only nontrivial dependency is a single call to `Main.main(...)`. A repo-wide `rg` found no other source file that references `GoogleJavaFormatTool` by name; the only related tests in `core/src/test/java/com/google/googlejavaformat/java/GoogleJavaFormatToolTest.java` load `Tool` via `ServiceLoader` rather than depending on this class directly. That is not hub-like modularization because there is no strong incoming-dependency evidence and the outgoing dependency set is small.
